acceptance.given: Repair validation captures the native command identity before and after repair.

oracle.expected: Pre-repair and post-repair executable and argument identities are byte-for-byte equal, with comparison evidence recorded.
forbidden: Any native command executable, argument vector, wrapper, or invocation identity changes.
oracle.observable: Validator output contains pre_identity, post_identity, and an equality result.

acceptance.then: Identity comparison is evaluated before acceptance.
acceptance.when: During repair validation after candidate files are prepared.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Change the native command executable or argument vector and verify identity comparison fails.
Remove pre/post identity evidence and verify acceptance fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Capture, recompute, and compare exact native command identity across repair; reject changes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; restore prior identity comparison logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: identity captured -> repair -> identity recomputed -> equal accepted or changed rejected
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Acceptance requires recorded equality of pre- and post-repair native command identities.

acceptance.given: A detached negative Probe declares concrete input and output bindings and an independently launchable command.

oracle.expected: The runner launches a distinct subprocess, passes bound inputs, captures bound outputs, and evaluates the negative result from that process.
forbidden: The Probe runs in-process or is simulated.
Inputs or outputs are unbound or omitted.
oracle.observable: Execution evidence contains a distinct process identifier, resolved input bindings, output bindings, and result status.

acceptance.then: Detached-process and I/O binding evidence are checked before Probe acceptance.
acceptance.when: When a detached negative Probe executes.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the negative Probe only in the parent process and verify detached-process assertion fails.
Remove an input or output binding and verify evaluation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Run detached negative Probes through scripts/vdd/probe_real_worker.py as independent processes with explicit bound inputs and outputs.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema migration; restore prior detached invocation path.

slice_hint.state_transition: inputs resolved -> worker spawned -> outputs captured -> negative verdict evaluated
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Acceptance requires independent-process evidence proving bound inputs and outputs.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result succeeded and includes all listed non-authority bindings.

oracle.expected: An independent verifier rechecks every non-authority binding against resolved artifact identities and records a pass only when all match.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result is accepted without independent binding verification.
Verification merely repeats the producer success flag.
oracle.observable: The result contains an independently produced, binding-by-binding verification record.

acceptance.then: Independent verification is evaluated after replay success and before final acceptance.
acceptance.when: When a Replay Result transitions to successful.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Delete the independent verification record while leaving replay success true and verify acceptance fails.
Alter one non-authority binding identity and verify the independent verifier rejects the result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Independently resolve and compare every non-authority binding for successful Replay Results and require the resulting evidence record.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema change; restore prior replay acceptance behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: replay success -> bindings independently resolved -> compared -> verified or rejected
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Acceptance requires independent verification of every listed non-authority binding.

acceptance.given: Each applicable Consumer is registered in the Toolchain Consumer Manifest and exposes a real disable call surface.

oracle.expected: Evaluation invokes disable through each Consumer's concrete real call surface and records successful execution.
forbidden: Disable uses a mock, stub, or synthetic path only.
oracle.observable: Consumer evidence identifies the concrete callable surface, invocation status, and successful disable result.

acceptance.then: Real-call-surface evidence is evaluated before Consumer acceptance.
acceptance.when: When disable is exercised for each applicable Consumer.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Route disable through a mock or simulated Consumer and verify real-call-surface assertion fails.
Skip disable invocation and verify successful Consumer evidence is absent.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Resolve each applicable Consumer from the manifest and invoke disable through its registered real call surface, recording invocation and result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema migration; restore prior Consumer dispatch behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Consumer selected -> real disable call -> result recorded -> accepted or failed
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Acceptance requires every applicable Consumer to have successful disable evidence from its concrete real call surface.
